text:
maria: kicking off bring-up for Galatea-5B — new 5B LLM variant from partner. Need a quant plan and quick qual/perf checks. target: ~2-3x token-cost reduction vs fp16 with <=1% latency increase and <1.5% MRR/regression on our evals. who can own initial experiments?
jon: +1, happy to lead int8 gguf baseline. my proposal: run calibrated symmetric int8 (per-channel where available), record MRR, ppl, and generation-quality diffs on our standard eval-suite. if int8 fails, try block-fp8 hybrid paths.
priya: suggest we also capture per-layer sensitivity (activation & weight) and a small set of hard prompts for behavioral checks (hallucination, math small-context). calibration scripts should emit token-level logprobs so we can compute KL and logit-gap metrics.
sam: I can run perf on cluster nodes (A100/H100 pools). plan: batch sizes [1,4,8], seq lens [128,512], measure p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec. I'll do both exclusive-run and shared-run to see tail behavior.
maria: thanks. jon — can you sketch a minimally viable experiment matrix? just enough to triage.
jon: matrix draft:
- precisions: fp16 baseline, int8-gguf (symmetric), int8-gguf (asymmetric), fp8-hybrid (if available)
- datasets: eval-suite/short-dialog (1k), eval-suite/long-form (200), regen-hard-prompts (50)
- metrics: MRR@10, accuracy on math sets, ppl, token-LL KL vs fp16, latency p50/p95
- calibration modes: per-layer calibration using 1k random tokens, and per-bucket (seq len) calibrations
I can start int8 symmetric + fp16 baselines today.
priya: note — for gguf int8 we need to run the gguf-export script with --preserve-scales and then run calib-runner that outputs per-layer scale histograms. sample cmd:
```bash
python tools/gguf_export.py --model checkpoints/galatea5b --out galatea5b.gguf --precision int8
python tools/calib_runner.py --gguf galatea5b.gguf --calib-set datasets/eval-short.jsonl --out calib/galatea5b-int8.json
```
Collect calib/galatea5b-int8.json artifacts for the qual triage.
jon: will push calib artifacts to gs://redwood-quant/galatea5b/ with timestamps.
sam: deployed a short perf job on A100: job 298712. baseline fp16 p50=72ms seq128 batch1, int8 p50=58ms same config. I'll post full table when finished.
quant-bot: job 298712 status: STARTED (owner: sam)
maria: great — priya, can you define the acceptance gates for QA? what thresholds do we require to call int8 safe to ship as a model variant?
priya: acceptance gates (proposal):
- MRR drop <= 1.5% relative to fp16 on main eval-suite
- KL(token distribution) <= 0.02 average across datasets
- No new failures on regen-hard-prompts (0 -> 2 failures allowed max)
- Gen-quality manual spot-check (5 artifacts) ok for hallucination/consistency
- Latency improvement >= 1.5x cost reduction target or tokens/sec gain >= 1.5x
If any gate fails, escalate to fp8-hybrid or adjust calibration.
jon: adding small smoke checklist for PR reviewers:
- run `./check_calib.py calib/galatea5b-int8.json` -> ensures scales within expected ranges\- run eval harness: `pytest tests/eval_harness/test_galatea.py::test_mrr --model galatea5b --precision int8`
sam: reminder: measure memory footprint too — int8 can still have kv-cache dominated memory. track peak-resident.
maria: assigned owners: jon (quant experiments & artifacts), sam (perf runs & tables), priya (gates and calibration tweaks). I'll coordinate rollout if we pass gates.
jon: starting int8 runs now, ETA artefacts in ~6h. posting job ids when done.
priya: will also run a small cross-check with our regression harness (A/B diffs) once jon's artifacts are up.
sam: perf run finished (A100): fp16 p95=110ms, int8 p95=88ms, tokens/sec fp16=320, int8=470 for seq128 batch1. numbers look promising. uploading csv.
maria: :eyes: good. jon — prioritize the regen-hard-prompts subset, we care about rare failure modes.
jon: noted. starting regen-hard 50-case sweep next.
quant-bot: upload complete: gs://redwood-quant/galatea5b/2245123456/ (artifacts: calib.json, eval_summary.csv, perf_table.csv)
priya: quick note — for fp8 experiments later, use hybrid path (weights int8, activations fp8) to reduce divergence risk. also keep reproducibility flags: seed=42 and disable dropout.
maria: timeline check — aim to have go/no-go recommendation by EOD tomorrow. if int8 passes gates we can prepare gguf bundle for hosted catalog.
jon: upload done: eval_summary shows MRR drop 0.9% on main eval, KL=0.015, regen-hard had 1 new failure (within gate). calib report attached.
priya: looks within acceptance. request: sample 5 generated outputs from regen-hard before/after and add short notes. I'll do manual spot-checks.
sam: I'll run H100 perf in morning for final numbers and include shared-run results.
maria: thanks team — good momentum. i'll create a quick console ticket for cataloging the variant and include rollout notes.
jon: :thumbsup:
priya: :white_check_mark:
quant-bot: ticket created: RNW-4521 (catalog:galatea5b-int8)
maria: last check — anyone foresee obvious failure modes we missed?
jon: maybe tokenizer quirks in gguf path; I ran tokenization smoke already.
priya: watch for subtle prompt-length sensitivity in calibration (split by seq buckets).
sam: no other blockers from infra side.
maria: ok closing thread for now; will reopen if regressions show up. thanks all.
